capabilities.notes: 8 placement patterns (grid/circle/arc/spiral/line/wave/helix/radial) via procedural_place, plus arena_generate - real, already-working capability.

physics_add_joint constructs JointFixed/JointHinge/JointSlider, but exact constructor signatures were not verified against a live UNIGINE SDK (see the caveat at the top of PhysicsTools.cs) - kept honestly at 'partial' rather than claiming 'supported' for code that could not be compiled or run against the real engine. Not required by any of the 5 currently-unlocked gameplay patterns.

interaction_create ensures the target has a real physics shape/body (so physics_raycast_query can detect it) and records the interaction type in a persisted, queryable JSON registry (interaction_get/interaction_list), for all 10 gameplay mechanics plus legacy triggers. Honest scope: unlike the Unity adapter's Runtime/QFoldITInteractable.cs, this does NOT wire a live click-to-callback - UNIGINE's Input/callback API needs SDK-version verification this adapter doesn't have access to (see InteractionTools.cs's header). Real, working infrastructure at the adapter level; not a live event system.

scientific_visualization_create realizes every scientific_subject/<mechanic> UAG node type as a real, visible, mechanic-differentiated primitive (shape + material preset keyed by mechanic), plus a real, persisted binding registry (scientific_binding_create/scientific_binding_get) holding the bound scientific-state:// URI as genuinely queryable data. Honest scope: unlike the Unity adapter, this does not attempt a floating 3D text label - UNIGINE's 3D text/billboard API needs SDK-version verification this adapter doesn't have access to.
